button.name: action_auto_detect_accounts
button.confirm: This will fill all empty account fields using the Saudi Arabia chart of accounts. Any missing accounts will be CREATED automatically. Continue?
button.title: Detects or creates all required accounts using KSA standard codes. Also links journals. Only fills empty fields — never overwrites.

ol.li: Click Auto-Setup All Accounts — detects accounts from your Saudi Arabia chart of accounts and creates any missing ones (KSA standard codes). Also links journals automatically.
Review the filled fields and adjust if needed.

field.name: payroll_journal_id
field.help: General journal used for salary posting journal entries. Usually named 'Payroll Journal' or 'Salary Journal'.

field.name: salary_expense_account_id
field.help: Expense account debited for each employee when salaries are posted. Typically '5100 - Salaries & Wages'.

field.name: salary_payable_account_id
field.help: Liability account credited for each employee (amount owed). Typically '2100 - Salaries Payable'.

field.name: bonus_expense_account_id
field.help: Bonus expense. Leave blank to use Salary Expense account.

field.name: petrol_expense_account_id
field.help: Petrol allowance. Leave blank to use Salary Expense account.

field.name: commission_income_account_id
field.help: Account type: Income / Revenue. Credited on commission customer invoices. Example: '4200 - Commission Income' or '4100 - Service Revenue'. This is a Profit & Loss income account that increases when you earn commission.

field.name: commission_journal_id
field.help: Journal type: Sales. Used for commission customer invoices (out_invoice). Usually your main 'Customer Invoices' or 'Sales' journal.

field.name: subcontractor_expense_account_id
field.help: Account type: Expense. Debited on vendor bills created for the subcontractor's net share of the receipt. Example: '5200 - Subcontractor Costs' or '5100 - Labour Costs'. Represents the cost to you of paying the subcontractor their portion.

page.name: commissioning

field.name: commissioning_payable_account_id
field.help: Example: 210002 Commissioning Business Payable. Credited on the subcontractor bill.

field.name: subcontractor_expense_account_id
field.help: Example: 520002 Commissioning Biz Exp. Debited on the subcontractor bill.

field.name: commissioning_purchase_journal_id
field.help: Example: BILL2 Commissioning Biz Purchases.

field.name: subcontractor_advance_account_id
field.help: Example: 142005 Advance To Subcontractor. Read for advance recovery.

field.name: commission_journal_id
field.help: The Commissioning sales journal for THIS company (e.g. INV1). Its posted invoices feed the settlement's invoice picker. This is the same journal shown on the Commission Receipts tab — one per-company setting, editable here or there.

field.name: commission_expense_account_id
field.help: Expense account debited on the salesperson commission bill.

page.div: Fix salesperson commission is applied once per client (not multiplied by invoice count). Gross Profit % is a percent of the realised commission (gross profit).

field.name: truck_revenue_account_id
field.help: Account type: Income / Revenue. Credited on customer invoices created for truck trips. Example: '4300 - Transport Revenue' or '4100 - Fleet Income'. This is a Profit & Loss income account.

field.name: truck_trip_journal_id
field.help: Journal type: Sales. Used for truck trip customer invoices (out_invoice). Usually your 'Customer Invoices' or 'Sales' journal.

field.name: rental_income_account_id
field.help: Account type: Income / Revenue. Credited on customer invoices for equipment/machinery rentals. Example: '4310 - Equipment Rental Income' or '4300 - Transport Revenue'. This is a Profit & Loss income account.

field.name: rental_journal_id
field.help: Journal type: Sales. Used for equipment rental customer invoices (out_invoice). Leave blank to fall back to the Truck Trip journal.

field.name: rental_expense_account_id
field.help: Account type: Expense. Debited on vendor bills for equipment rented FROM vendors (generators, cranes, etc.). Falls back to Truck Expense Account.

field.name: rental_expense_journal_id
field.help: Journal type: Purchase. For inbound equipment rental vendor bills. Falls back to Truck Expense Journal.

field.name: truck_expense_account_id
field.help: Account type: Expense. Debited on maintenance vendor bills AND on trip operational cost journal entries (fuel, driver, other). Example: '5300 - Vehicle Maintenance & Fleet Costs'. This is a Profit & Loss expense account.

field.name: truck_costs_payable_account_id
field.help: Account type: Current Liability. Credited when trip operational costs (fuel, driver, other) are posted as a journal entry via 'Post Trip Costs' button on each trip. Example: '2150 - Truck Costs Payable' or '2100 - Accrued Expenses'. Debited when you actually pay the fuel supplier or driver.

field.name: truck_expense_journal_id
field.help: Journal type: General or Purchase. Used for trip operational cost journal entries (fuel, driver, other costs). Leave blank to fall back to the Employee Compliance Journal.

field.name: investor_payable_account_id
field.help: Account type: Expense or Liability. Used on vendor bills created for investor profit share payments. Example: '5500 - Investor Profit Share' (Expense) or '2200 - Investor Payable' (Liability). Choose Expense if you want the profit share to flow through P&L, or Liability if you want a balance sheet clearing account.

field.name: installment_payable_account_id
field.help: Account type: Liability (non-current or current). Debited when an installment payment journal entry is created for a financed vehicle. Example: '2210 - Installment Payable' or '2220 - Vehicle Financing Liability'. Credit side is filled by the user on the draft journal entry (Bank/Cash account).

field.name: manpower_approver_ids
field.help: Required. The authorised approvers for manpower invoices, bills and budget confirmations. Any ONE of them can decide a request — a single signature completes it. All of them see the pending queue. Nobody can approve their own request, so configure at least two people if the same person also raises them.

field.name: manpower_sign_template_id
field.help: Approval requests are routed to this Sign template, with the signer set automatically from the Approvers above. Signing produces the signed PDF, the signer record and the Sign audit trail. Leave empty to decide directly in Manpower → Approvals.

group.div: No Approvers set. Invoices, bills and budget confirmations on manpower contracts are blocked until you choose at least one.
No Sign template set — approvals will be decided in Manpower → Approvals rather than signed in the Sign app.

field.name: manpower_income_account_id
field.help: Account type: Income / Revenue. Credited on customer invoices for manpower contracts. Example: '410001 - Direct Business Sale'. This is a Profit & Loss income account.

field.name: manpower_journal_id
field.help: Journal type: Sales. Used for manpower contract customer invoices (out_invoice). Usually your 'Customer Invoices' or 'Sales' journal.

field.name: manpower_receivable_account_id
field.help: Accounts-receivable account for Project Income tab invoices. Example: '140001 - Direct Business Receivable'. Kept separate per business division so cash-tracking is clean per division.

field.name: manpower_vat_output_account_id
field.help: Output VAT account for Project Income invoices. Example: '250000 - Output VAT'. Optional; if empty the tax record's own default account is used.

field.name: manpower_payable_account_id
field.help: Accounts-payable account credited on Project Expenses vendor bills. Example: '210001 - Manpower Payable'. Kept separate per business division.

field.name: project_expense_journal_id
field.help: Purchase journal used when 'Create Vendor Bill' is clicked on a project expense line (wages, accommodation, utilities, furniture). Leave blank to use the default Purchase journal.

group.string: Project Expense Accounts (Debit on vendor bill)

field.name: project_wages_account_id
field.help: Expense account debited for Worker Wages bills. Example: 5200 — Project Labour Cost.

field.name: project_accommodation_account_id
field.help: Expense account debited for Accommodation bills. Example: 5210 — Accommodation & Housing.

field.name: project_utilities_account_id
field.help: Expense account debited for Utilities bills. Example: 5220 — Project Utilities.

field.name: project_furniture_account_id
field.help: Expense account debited for Furniture & Equipment bills. Example: 5230 — Project Equipment & Supplies.

field.name: project_transport_account_id
field.help: Expense account debited for Transport bills. Example: 5240 — Project Transport.

field.name: project_other_expense_account_id
field.help: Expense account debited for Other project expense bills. Example: 5290 — Other Project Expenses.

group.string: Expense Category → GL Account (15-category KSA map, used by Project Expenses + Project Budget tabs)

page.div: How it works: On a Manpower Contract (Project type), open the Project Expenses tab and add each cost line. Click Create Vendor Bill on any line to post it to Accounts Payable. All bills are tagged with the contract's analytic account — view the full project P&L in Accounting → Reporting → Analytic Report.

field.name: commission_expense_account_id
field.help: Expense account debited on the vendor bill created from a Sales Person Commission line on a Manpower Contract. Example: 620010 — Sales Commission Expense.

group.div: How commissions compute: On a Manpower Contract, pick a Commission Type next to the Salesperson. On the new Sales Person Commission tab, add a payout line — Amount auto-fills from this employee's rate for the picked type. Percentage modes are gated: Actual Profit must be > 0 for any payout. Missing template for an employee yields zero; Create Bill raises a clear error.

A simple list of product names for Project Income and Project Direct Cost lines. It does not touch the GL account or the 15% VAT. Untick Active to retire an entry while keeping it on historical records.

page.div: Configure accounts for KSA statutory costs: GOSI, Iqama, Insurance, Saudization. Click Post Expenses on a confirmed Employee Cost record to create the journal entry.

field.name: employee_cost_journal_id
field.help: Journal type: General or Purchase. Used for GOSI, Iqama, Insurance, and Saudization journal entries. Usually a dedicated 'Payroll Costs' or 'General' journal. Does NOT need a Default Account as each line has its own account.

field.name: compliance_payable_account_id
field.help: Account type: Current Liability (Balance Sheet). Credited when compliance costs are posted. Debited when you actually pay GOSI / government authority. Example: '2300 - GOSI & Compliance Payable' or '2100 - Other Payables'. This accumulates your outstanding statutory obligations.

field.name: gosi_expense_account_id
field.help: Account type: Expense (P&L). Debited for employer GOSI contributions at 11.75% of basic salary. Example: '5600 - GOSI Employer Contribution'. GOSI is the General Organization for Social Insurance — mandatory social security in Saudi Arabia.

field.name: iqama_expense_account_id
field.help: Account type: Expense (P&L). Debited for Iqama (Iqāma) residency permit renewal fees for expatriate employees. Example: '5610 - Iqama & Residency Costs'. Usually amortized monthly (annual cost ÷ 12).

field.name: insurance_expense_account_id
field.help: Account type: Expense (P&L). Debited for mandatory employee medical insurance premiums. Example: '5620 - Medical Insurance'. Mandatory health coverage required by KSA labour law for all employees.

field.name: saudization_expense_account_id
field.help: Account type: Expense (P&L). Debited for Saudization (Nitaqat) compliance-related fees. Example: '5630 - Saudization / Nitaqat'. Costs related to meeting the Ministry of HR's Saudi national employment quota requirements.

field.name: other_compliance_account_id
field.help: Account type: Expense (P&L). Debited for the 'Other Costs' field on Employee Cost records — any miscellaneous compliance cost that doesn't fit the categories above. Example: '5640 - Other Staff Compliance Costs'.

field.name: default_analytic_account_id
field.help: Analytic / cost centre account used as the company-wide fallback. Applied to payslip lines, freelancer bills, commission invoices, fleet invoices, and compliance journal entries when no specific analytic account is set on the individual document. Example: 'Operations - Main Branch'. Individual documents (Salary Import, Commission Receipt, Truck Trip, Manpower Contract) can override this with their own Analytic Account field.

page.div: Individual records (Salary Import, Commission Receipt, Truck Trip) also have their own Analytic Account field which overrides this default. Use the default here for your main cost centre or branch.
